name: The Binding
summary: In the Undercity, an initiate faces the rite that grants command of a succubus. Carendin Halgar directs the warlock to use Pure Hearts to draw a demon from the Twisting Nether into a ritual circle, then master it through combat.

sections.title: A Test of Will
sections.body: In the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Forsaken warlocks hone their command of demons. Summoning a succubus marks a critical passage in their training. A voidwalker relies on brute force, and an imp on lesser malice, but a succubus can ensnare its summoner with seductive and mental enchantments. Carendin Halgar demands that each initiate prove mind and magic unshakable before he entrusts them with lasting dominion over such a demon.

sections.title: Subjugation in the Circle
sections.body: Pure Hearts gathered from innocent souls in the Wetlands and Silverpine Forest open a passage to the Twisting Nether. A succubus summoned into the binding circle attacks at once, seeking to overpower or entrance the warlock. The warlock must break its physical form and cast its essence back into the void to claim mastery and learn to summon the demon at will.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The rite lets Forsaken warlocks prove they can master a succubus. By summoning and defeating one in the Magic Quarter, a warlock proves its charms cannot sway them and earns the power to summon and command one in battle.

Carendin Halgar trains warlocks in the Undercity's Magic Quarter and oversees the training and trials of Forsaken spellcasters. He tests their mental endurance and dark arts before entrusting them with more dangerous summoning rites.

faq.q: Why were pure hearts needed to summon the demon?
faq.answer: Pure Hearts gathered in earlier steps serve as irresistible metaphysical bait for a succubus. The hearts draw the demon through the summoning circle to manifest in the mortal realm.

faq.q: Where does the summoning take place?
aliases: where do i summon the succubus
faq.answer: The summoning takes place in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, in a ritual circle near Carendin Halgar and the warlock mentors.

faq.q: Why does the succubus need to be slain?
faq.answer: Warlocks do not negotiate with their minions; they subjugate them. By shattering the succubus's form in the circle, the warlock bends its spirit to their will, so it returns as a thrall rather than a master.

faq.q: Are succubi dangerous to Undercity warlocks?
faq.answer: Yes. A succubus's charms have bound many strong minds, despite the Forsaken's resilience against fear and sleep. Carelessness in the ritual can bring death or enslavement.

angles.text: As a warlock, this rite marks a crucial step in your dark path. It tests your power to master seductive mental forces and bind cunning Nether-spawn to your will.
As Forsaken, you use whatever dark tools are needed to secure survival and dominion in Lordaeron. Demonic subjugation is a practical means to those ends.
